reported.title: No hysteresis: fan turns off below 42 C instead of holding until 38 C
reported.description: The control logic uses a single trip point: line 66 turns the fan ON only when lastTempC >= FAN_ON_C (42.0) and the else branch at lines 70-73 turns it OFF for any value below 42.0, so the required 38.0 C release threshold is never implemented. With the override released at a temperature between 38 and 42 C the fan is driven LOW even though the spec requires it to stay ON, producing the measured 'D8 was not LOW for 809 ms while required' violation starting at 1.00 s in the 'Override held during cold then hot' scenario. D8 was in the wrong state for 3053 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 1.00 s: D8 was not LOW for 1051 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Relay chatters because each 50 ms sample re-evaluates a noisy threshold with no filtering or debounce
reported.description: Every 50 ms sample (line 53-56) reads A0 and immediately drives the relay from that single raw reading via lines 66-73, with no averaging, no hysteresis band, and no minimum-state-time guard. Sensor noise around the trip point therefore flips D8 on every sample, giving the measured '57 toggles' in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms and '34 toggles' in the rapid-oscillation scenario, far above the limit of 2. D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2), and 77 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (Fan switching limit)

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
